description: บอง 2026-07-28: when the BE (NestJS :4000) is not booted, the FE BFF (/api/*) answers 502 upstream-unreachable, the captured page falls back, and the browser logs a red console error. A reviewer reads that as a UI BUG — it is infra (BE not running). มุน hit exactly this on Zone 4 (GET /api/chinese-horoscope 502 while the rest of the page was fine). Fix: harness/backend-hint.ts (pure) turns the signal into a plain-language line, and capture-route.ts (the team review-capture tool) now collects 4xx/5xx responses and prints it after the summary — the tool EXPLAINS what it sees, it does NOT auto-boot the env (บอง: a tool should describe, not silently mutate the environment). NARROW on purpose (บอง: not noise): fires ONLY on HTTP 502 to an /api path — the BFF 502s only when its fetch to BE throws; a 404/500 from a BE that IS up is a DIFFERENT problem and is deliberately NOT claimed to be BE-not-booted (stay silent rather than print a confident wrong line). verify-the-instrument BOTH ways (บอง: a one-directional test cannot tell correct from always-on, มุน Zone-3 vacuous guard): unit test scripts/backend-hint.test.ts (9 cases) proves it FIRES on 502-on-/api AND STAYS SILENT on 500/404-on-/api, 502-off-/api, empty, and garbage; live proof through capture-route --route /v2: with BE UP the hint is ABSENT (errors=0, /api returns 200 from the merged null-guard), with BE killed the hint APPEARS (1 request to /api returned 502). Scope: harness/ only, no UI/prod/env. gate_layer=harness/tooling + infra-awareness.
